en.name: The Cat Adventurers
en.ability: Each day, a player who has never adventured may publicly volunteer to adventure. That night, if they are alive, you learn a player of the opposite alignment to them.

revisions.v1: Each day, a player who has never adventured may publicly volunteer to adventure. That night, if they are alive, you learn a player of the opposite alignment to them.

en.otherNightReminder: If today's *ADVENTURER* is alive, wake The Cat Adventurers & point to a player of the opposite alignment to them.

zh.name: 猫猫探险队
zh.ability: 每个白天，一名未曾探险的玩家可以公开申请探险。在当晚，如果他存活，你会得知一名与他阵营对立的玩家。

revisions.v1: 每个白天，一名未曾探险的玩家可以公开申请探险。在当晚，如果他存活，你会得知一名与他阵营对立的玩家。

zh.otherNightReminder: 如果当天的探险者存活，唤他并告知一名与探险者阵营对立的玩家。
